name: Showa Sangyo Co., Ltd.
note: Flour-milling and food-products company (SHOWA brand); listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange (code 2004). Major shareholders as of 31 March 2026 on its 株主の状況 page: ITOCHU Corporation (7.0%), The Master Trust Bank of Japan (Trust Account, 6.4%) and Mitsui & Co. (4.7%).
